name: Manage Paid WhatsApp VIP Group Access and Anti-Leak Moderation with Stripe, Google Sheets, Slack, and Supergreen

parameters.content:
## Manage paid WhatsApp VIP group access with Stripe, Supergreen, Sheets and Slack

### How it works

1. Listens to Stripe subscription webhooks, deduplicates retries, and automatically adds active subscribers to a private WhatsApp group via Supergreen (falling back to a private invite-link DM if WhatsApp privacy blocks direct addition).
2. Sends 48-hour Stripe Billing Portal grace warnings when payments go past due, and automatically removes canceled or unpaid members from the group.
3. Monitors live `participant_joined` group events to welcome verified paying members and immediately evict unauthorized joiners from leaked invite links.
4. Runs a daily 08:00 roster reconciliation comparing live WhatsApp group members against the Google Sheets ledger to evict expired grace-period or unlisted participants.
5. Logs lifecycle events, leak alerts, daily audit digests, and workflow errors to Slack.

### Setup steps

- [ ] Install the `n8n-nodes-supergreen` community node and ensure your connected WhatsApp number is a **Group Admin** in your VIP WhatsApp group.
- [ ] Connect credentials for **Stripe API**, **Supergreen API**, **Google Sheets OAuth2**, and **Slack OAuth2**.
- [ ] Create a Google Sheet with a `Members` tab containing columns: `customerId`, `subscriptionId`, `phone`, `memberName`, `email`, `planName`, `status`, `accessMethod`, `inGroup`, `graceExpiresAt`, `joinedAt`, `updatedAt`.
- [ ] Replace `SET_WHATSAPP_GROUP_ID`, `SET_GOOGLE_SHEET_ID`, `SET_SLACK_CHANNEL_ID`, `SET_ADMIN_PHONES_CSV`, and your checkout/billing URLs in the 3 configuration nodes and error alert node.
- [ ] Enable phone collection in Stripe Checkout (`phone_number_collection`) or store `metadata.whatsapp_phone` on Stripe customers.

### Customization

Adjust `graceHours` (default 48) in `Community Configuration`, edit the WhatsApp welcome and win-back copy, or swap Google Sheets for Airtable or Postgres as your member ledger.

## 1. Receive and deduplicate Stripe webhooks

Listens for subscription created, updated, and deleted events, deduplicates webhook retries, and loads community settings.

## 2. Fetch customer and route lifecycle

Retrieves the full Stripe customer record, normalizes their E.164 WhatsApp phone number, and routes by subscription status.

## 3. Add paying member to VIP group

Attempts direct WhatsApp group addition via Supergreen and checks whether privacy restrictions blocked the add.

## 4. Confirm direct add and update ledger

Sends an onboarding welcome DM on WhatsApp and upserts the member as Active in Google Sheets.

## 5. Send private invite link fallback

Fetches the private VIP group invite link when direct add is restricted, DMs it to the subscriber, and records pending join status.

## 6. Log new member in Slack

Posts a provisioning confirmation to the community ops channel once either access path succeeds.

## 7. Send 48h past-due grace warning

Generates a live Stripe Billing Portal session, DMs a payment update link, and logs the grace expiry timestamp in Google Sheets.

## 8. Remove churned member and notify

Removes canceled or unpaid subscribers from the VIP group, sends a rejoin DM, marks Removed in Sheets, and alerts Slack.

## 9. Monitor real-time VIP group joins

Triggers on Supergreen participant_joined events, filters for the target VIP group, and excludes configured admin numbers.

## 10. Verify joiner against paid ledger

Looks up each joining phone number in Google Sheets and checks whether they hold an Active or Past Due subscription.

## 11. Welcome verified paid member

Posts a personalized welcome message inside the VIP WhatsApp group and records the joined timestamp in Sheets.

## 12. Evict leaked-link joiner and alert

Immediately removes unauthorized joiners, DMs them the official checkout link, and flags a possible invite-link leak in Slack.

## 13. Fetch live WhatsApp group roster

Runs daily at 08:00 to pull current WhatsApp group participants via Supergreen and extract non-admin phone numbers.

## 14. Reconcile live group with ledger

Reads the Google Sheets ledger and identifies any unlisted participants or members whose 48h grace window has expired.

## 15. Evict expired or unlisted members

Removes out-of-sync members from the group, notifies them on WhatsApp, updates the sheet ledger, and logs evictions to Slack.

## 16. Post clean daily audit summary

Sends a concise confirmation digest to Slack when zero unauthorized or expired members are found.

## 17. Alert Slack on workflow errors

Captures any unhandled node failure via Error Trigger and posts the failing node and error details to Slack.
